classification.difficultyReason: Interpret equal vectors and apply the test that one pair of opposite sides is equal and parallel.

content.prompt: In the diagram, $\overrightarrow{WX}=\overrightarrow{ZY}$. Explain why $WXYZ$ is a parallelogram.

spec.description: Slanted quadrilateral WXYZ with rightward endpoint arrows from W to X and Z to Y. Connecting sides use thin black strokes instead of source grey.
spec.mathematics: The two supplied directed opposite sides have equal magnitude and direction. Both arrowheads and their endpoints are retained.
spec.answerVisibility: The entire diagram is supplied; no conclusion or solution annotation appears in the question figure.

answer.short: Equal vectors have the same magnitude and direction, so opposite sides $WX$ and $ZY$ are equal and parallel. Therefore $WXYZ$ is a parallelogram.
answer.worked: Since $\overrightarrow{WX}=\overrightarrow{ZY}$, sides $WX$ and $ZY$ have the same length and are parallel. A quadrilateral with one pair of opposite sides equal and parallel is a parallelogram. Hence $WXYZ$ is a parallelogram.
